history.dynasty: Parasurama tradition; patronage of the Maharaja of Travancore (who funds Utcha Pooja etc.)
history.period: Believed 11th century CE per one source; another claims 2000-3000 years (CONFLICT - unverified)
history.summary: Peruvanam Mahadeva Temple is an ancient Shiva temple on a 7-acre walled compound at Peruvanam, near Cherpu in Thrissur district (CSV town 'Thrissur' is approximate - corrected). The twin-sanctum shrine's chief deity is Irattayappan, Shiva worshipped in Ardhanareeswara (half-male, half-female) form facing west, said to have been installed by Parashurama; a second sanctum houses Matathilappan. It is under the rare joint administration of the Cochin and Travancore Devaswom Boards, with the Travancore Maharaja historically funding the Utcha Pooja. The Peruvanam Pooram, celebrated for a claimed 1500 years (unverified), is one of Kerala's oldest temple festivals - the Thrissur Pooram (200 years) is said to have originated here - and the temple is a famed centre of Kathakali. Note the claim that the temple is 2000-3000 years old conflicts with the 11th-century attribution; neither is inscriptionally verified here.

name: Peruvanam Mahadeva Temple
town_description: Peruvanam is a village near Cherpu in Thrissur district, about 10 km from Thrissur city; legend derives its name from sage Puru's penance in the forest (vanam). It is one of the most ancient temple settlements in Kerala, and Cherpu is its postal/railway locality. The area sits on the coastal plain of central Kerala with paddy fields and backwaters nearby.

travel.railway: Ollur Railway Station about 5.8 km; Thrissur station about 10 km (verify)
travel.road: About 10 km from Thrissur railway station via Cherpu road; Thrissur Bus Stand about 7 km (verify)

visitor_information.best_time: Early morning; Peruvanam Pooram season (March-April); Maha Shivaratri
visitor_information.opening_hours: 5:00 AM - 10:30 AM and 5:00 PM - 7:30 PM (verify - one source says 6 AM - 11 AM / 4 PM - 8 PM). Traditional dress code; photography and mobiles restricted.
